title: Electrocardiographic Mapping and Imaging
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate a novel non-invasive cardiac electric imaging methodology for localizing and imaging cardiac electrical activity from body surface electrocardiographic recordings in patients with ventricular tachycardia (VT). Using non-invasive means will increase our ability to correctly diagnose cardiac abnormalities, and aid ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, offering enhanced performance to what currently exists.
